label: OpenAPI with oasdiff
description: Checks the compatibility of the OpenAPI specification with a reference revision using oasdiff. Comes in by evidence: only when the workspace has an OpenAPI specification (openapi.yaml, openapi.yml or openapi.json). The reference is the baseRef (or baseSpec) of the oasdiff instance in .jgates/tools.yml; until it is set, or when it does not resolve, the stage is blocked, never passed. The tool is supplied by you (jgates doctor says where to get it).
